data.name: Impetuous
data.detailed_description:
The Painted Realms are rotting, slowly succumbing to a corruption which threatens to erase everything if left unchecked, leaving the denizens of these worlds adrift.

Play as Ember the Imp and utilize an array of movement and combat abilities to make your way though these broken worlds, collecting upgrades to unlock new techniques and reach new areas.

Explore interconnected worlds and gather enough strength to face the source of the corruption which threatens to devour everything.

You will...

  • Traverse expansive worlds which encourage exploration at your own pace, with hidden upgrades and secrets around every corner.

  • Use fluid movement abilities such as air dashes, wall bounces, and more to explore the world.

  • Fight your way though corrupted enemies with swift movement and nimble dodging.

  • Immerse yourself in the otherworldly Painted Realms, with surreal audio and visual design.

  • Collect a variety of outfits for Ember to wear! (She is cute.)

  • Complete your journey in a couple of hours, then replay to take a different path and collect upgrades in a new order.

data.short_description: After her home was suddenly erased, Ember the Imp must traverse the corrupted and decaying Painted Realms to uncover the truth. Explore surreal and interconnected worlds, collect upgrades to expand your movement abilities, and fight strange and warped enemies in this Metroidvania 3D Platformer!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Quad Core 2.5 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1060 or Equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Minimum requirements are an estimation. Please try the demo to see if it works on your system.

content_descriptors.notes: The main character's design is sexually suggestive and several of the unlockable outfits are revealing, but there is no explicit content in the game. There is also body jiggle physics on the main character, but this can be disabled in the options menu.
